title: Condon Report and its links to atomic secrecy

tellings.quote: And then you find out that he was, you know, very close friends with Oenheimer going back to, you know, their studies at Gotten in Germany in the 20s.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, points out that physicist Edward Condon, who led the Condon Report, a late 1960s UFO study done in Colorado for the US Air Force, was close friends with Robert Oppenheimer, head of the atomic bomb lab at Los Alamos, going back to their student days in Göttingen, Germany, in the 1920s. Michels links this to the secrecy of the atomic age, naming a Los Alamos teaching document and the laws that put atomic knowledge under tight government control. If he is right, it would mean the study of UFOs was shaped by the same people and habits that kept the bomb secret.
